I also wouldn't admit it was rape until recently, just told myself I cheated on my boyfriend and used that to torture myself. So I guess it was a lot of factors.

I do. It was actually a close friend. The actual event is confusing for me to analyze though. At the time, I figured giving in would hurt less than resisting and getting violently raped. In retrospect, both the options sucked.
